family_first_publication.verification_scope: Known first in reviewed family index and experiment/reference attribution; not exhaustive proof of no prior disclosure.

assay_conditions.format: one-armed monovalent VHH-Fc with common knob/hole Fc design
assay_conditions.running_buffer: PBS-P+; source describes stock as 10x, do not infer a final salt concentration from that wording

public_study_information.text: Each molecule is an anti-IL-2Rbeta VHH in the same one-armed VHH-Fc format. The VHH-Fc molecules were captured on an anti-PGLALA CM3 surface. Recombinant human or cynomolgus IL-2Rbeta-gamma extracellular-domain constructs were injected as analytes in a Biacore T200 assay at 25 C, using PBS-P+ buffer, a top receptor concentration of 150 nM and threefold serial dilutions. Association and dissociation were monitored for 240 s and 600 s, respectively; KD values were reported from a 1:1 Langmuir fit and are in nM. Predict ratios of the reported matched SPR KD values. The source does not provide replicate-level uncertainty for these table entries.

review.notes: Local PDF sequences and assay entries reviewed; source-supported rows only. See extracted evidence and disclosure review for uncertainty and omissions.
